body:
1. bin/hook-runner.sh: replace non-POSIX test -O (SC3067) at lines 29, 129, 142 with POSIX owned_by_euid() via find -H -prune -user, and remove unused LAUNCHER_DIR (SC2034) at line 432.
2. test/hook-runner.test.mjs: add static check rejecting non-POSIX test -O/-G/-N primaries, and fix dash stdin_pid/child pid test race via victim ready marker, newline-terminated pidfile read before overwrite, and --timeout 2.
3. test/policy-1-5-9-sed-notebook.test.mjs: probe GNU sed (required on Linux) with (-i, -e, expr, tmpFile) across all 22 accepted expressions, and run BSD sed (-i, empty, -e, expr, tmpFile) on macOS across the 21 POSIX expressions.
title: Fix POSIX sh shellcheck warnings, BSD sed macOS portability, and dash stdin_pid test race
